topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I stepped into the dim office, the rain still dripping from my coat. The kid was sitting there, a world of hurt behind his eyes, an essay printed and pinned to the board like a butterfly. He didn't say much, just handed me the paper. My mind raced. I should have vetted this more, dug deeper. Turns out, the essay that was supposed to be his ticket out, his one shot at something better, had been lifted, a shiny example for all to see. I promised him I'd make it right, but the words felt hollow, even to me. This city, it eats you whole, and sometimes, you’re left wondering how you ended up feeding it.
